analysis:
Both changed files are test-only (provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Coordinator/CoordinatorClientTests.swift and CoordinatorIntegrationTests.swift). No production source, attestation, encryption, authorization or key-handling code is modified, so nothing here alters the TB-002 or TB-009 controls.

CoordinatorClientTests.swift (head lines 578-591): the backoff test changes from sampling `nextDelay()` to asserting exact `nextDelayRange()` values ([0.5...1, 1...2, 2...4, 2...4], then 0.5...1 after reset). This implies a new production API (`nextDelayRange`) in ExponentialBackoff that is outside the supplied evidence. Equal-jitter reconnect backoff is availability behavior only.

CoordinatorIntegrationTests.swift: header comments now say the suite runs in provider CI via scripts/run-provider-tests.sh instead of being skipped in release builds. That improves test coverage and is not a security regression. Two new tests are added: a 1012 (service restart) close must reconnect within 1.5 s, and a session open past a configurable stable duration must reset the backoff. The patch also adds a `CoordinatorReconnectPolicy` injected into `CoordinatorClient.init` (a production type not visible here), and helpers that close the mock socket with a given code and measure the time to re-register.

Unverified contracts for the next pass: the production reconnect logic.
- A coordinator-sent 1012 close bypasses the backoff. The coordinator is trusted, but the next pass should check that a compromised or misbehaving endpoint cannot hammer reconnects or avoid the delay.
- A reduced stable-session duration (1 s in the test) should not be the default.
- Every reconnect must still re-sign a fresh attestation and re-register (the existing test coordinatorRegistrationRegeneratesAttestationOnReconnect covers this; TB-009 requires re-signing on every reconnect).
- Reconnect must not carry stale App Attest authorization (T-053).
No concrete vulnerability is supported by the test-only diff, and the production diff was not supplied, so the review is incomplete there.
